rows.purpose: HERO — kitabın ne olduğu tek bakışta
rows.headline: Not a puzzle book with a mythology theme
rows.body: Every puzzle is built out of what a people actually made: a writing system, a counting system, a map of a real place, a message that had to travel. 120 puzzles across 22 cultures.
rows.alt: A closed navy field notebook with a gold compass emblem lying on a wooden desk beside a folded map, a pencil and a coil of rope.

rows.purpose: ÇOCUK NE YAPIYOR — çöz · diz · mühürle
rows.headline: Work it out. Write it down. Earn the seal.
rows.body: Children decode, sort and draw their way through the book — then press a seal at the end of every region.
rows.panelBody: A key is printed on the page and a line is ruled beneath it. Every answer comes from the plate — never from something a child is expected to already know.
rows.alt: A child's hands writing with a pencil on the ruled page of an open field notebook.

rows.purpose: ÇOCUK NE YAPIYOR — çöz · diz · mühürle
rows.headline: Work it out. Write it down. Earn the seal.
rows.body: Children decode, sort and draw their way through the book — then press a seal at the end of every region.
rows.panelBody: Cards arrive out of order with empty number boxes. The reader puts an account back the way it happened, then checks it against the page itself.
rows.alt: A child's hands arranging blank paper cards in a row on a wooden desk.

rows.purpose: ÇOCUK NE YAPIYOR — çöz · diz · mühürle
rows.headline: Work it out. Write it down. Earn the seal.
rows.body: Children decode, sort and draw their way through the book — then press a seal at the end of every region.
rows.panelBody: Six regions, six seals. The star box on each page collects one letter at a time until a region's seal word is complete.
rows.alt: A child's hand pressing a stamp beside a row of round seal impressions on a paper strip.

rows.purpose: KAPSAM — altı bölge, yirmi iki halk
rows.headline: Six regions. 22 peoples. One quest.
rows.body: From sea ice to cloud forest, the route crosses six regions and 22 cultures — each named by its own name.
rows.alt: Six painted landscape panels in a row: sea ice, a warm coastal town, open savanna, monsoon mountains, an island sea and cloud forest terraces.

rows.headline: Checked against museums, archives and universities
rows.body: Every cultural claim in the book was revalidated against primary and institutional sources, and the back of the book says which ones.
rows.alt: A stack of reference books, an archive folder, a magnifier and cotton handling gloves on a desk.

rows.purpose: SATIN ALMA GEREKÇESİ — masa başı, ekransız
rows.headline: A pencil. That is the whole kit.
rows.body: No screen, no app, no batteries. 156 pages a child writes in, at a table, with a pencil.
rows.panelBody: One book and one pencil. Nothing to charge, nothing to install and nothing that needs a grown-up's password.
rows.alt: A closed navy field notebook with a gold compass emblem beside a single sharpened pencil.

rows.purpose: SATIN ALMA GEREKÇESİ — masa başı, ekransız
rows.headline: A pencil. That is the whole kit.
rows.body: No screen, no app, no batteries. 156 pages a child writes in, at a table, with a pencil.
rows.panelBody: Ruled writing space on every page, measured against the hand of an eight-year-old rather than an adult's.
rows.alt: An open field notebook showing blank ruled and gridded pages with a pencil resting across them.

rows.purpose: SATIN ALMA GEREKÇESİ — masa başı, ekransız
rows.headline: A pencil. That is the whole kit.
rows.body: No screen, no app, no batteries. 156 pages a child writes in, at a table, with a pencil.
rows.panelBody: A quest with an ending. When the sixth seal is in, the last page opens and the certificate is filled in.
rows.alt: The closed field notebook beside a mug and a switched-off desk lamp at the end of a session.

rows.purpose: AKTİVİTE TÜRLERİ — harita · kod · gözlem · sıralama
rows.headline: Maps, keys, plates and cards
rows.body: Four kinds of work, 120 times over: trace a real coast, build a key, label a plate, put an account back in order.
rows.alt: Four activity sheets fanned across a desk: an outline coast map, a ruled key panel with empty cells, an observation plate and blank numbered cards.

rows.headline: Six seals, and a certificate at the end
rows.body: The book is a single quest with an ending. Six regions, six seals, and a final page that only opens when all six are in.
rows.alt: The finished field notebook closed on a desk beside a blank certificate card and a folded map.
